# Mat Hayward

> Landscape and travel photography by Mat Hayward, a photographer based in the Trossachs, Scotland. Galleries from Scotland and further afield, maps of the locations where photos were taken, and short write-ups of mountains climbed.

Mat also writes [Slow Scotland](https://slowscotland.uk), a free 12-week email journey through Scotland's quieter places.
